name: Randolph-Brooks Federal Credit Union
notes: Researched from public rbfcu.org FAQ pages only (no sign-in). The bill is an RBFCU loan payment. In Online Banking, View Accounts shows the 10-day and 15-day payoff amounts; the loan's three-dot menu ('I Want To...') > Make Payment opens the Transfer Funds screen (Next, then Submit). Automatic payments are recurring transfers made with Move Money / Make a Payment > Schedule for Future (Frequency, Start Date, End Date), or arranged with a Consumer Lending Specialist when the loan closes (which may draw from another institution). Online methods are bank transfers only (inferred: no card option documented). Sign-in is username + password; sign-in verification uses push, text or email for unrecognized devices, and members may keep OTP by text or phone call or security questions instead of app MFA (modelled as text). Paperless Preference covers statements and documents (also enrolls by texting PAPERLESS to 968772); credit cards enroll separately on the card servicing site. Up to 24 months of statements are online; older copies via chat, 210-945-3300 or a branch. Skip-A-Pay costs $15 per skip, not two months in a row, at most two per calendar year. Auto loan due-date changes go through Collections at 210-945-3300 after the first payment. No public no-login payment page was found.

sources.title: Skip-A-Pay - Skip Your Loan Payment Any Time of Year | RBFCU

autopay.note: Automatic loan payments are recurring transfers: Make a Payment > Schedule for Future with a Frequency, Start Date and End Date.

guest_pay.note: RBFCU loans are paid by transfer in Online Banking or the RBFCU Mobile app after signing in; there is no pay-without-signing-in page. Call 210-945-3300 for help.

payment_arrangement.note: RBFCU has no online repayment plan. Eligible auto and personal loans can use Skip-A-Pay ($15) in Online Banking or the app; otherwise call 210-945-3300.

help.title: View and pay your RBFCU loan
paragraphs: Sign in to Online Banking. On the View Accounts tab you can see the 10-day and 15-day payoff amounts for each loan.
Click the three vertical dots next to the loan in the Loans section, choose Make Payment from the I Want To menu, fill in the Transfer Funds screen, click Next, check the details and click Submit.
steps: Find the loan under Loans and click the three dots.
Complete Transfer Funds, click Next, then Submit.

help.title: Automatic payments for your loan
paragraphs: The easiest way is to tell your Consumer Lending Specialist while finalizing the loan; automatic payments can come from an RBFCU account or another institution.

You can also set up a recurring transfer: in Online Banking or the RBFCU Mobile app go to the loan, select Make a Payment, complete the transfer details and choose Schedule for Future, then pick the Frequency, Start Date and End Date. For help call 210-945-3300 or start a chat in Online Banking.
steps: Open the loan and select Make a Payment.
Complete the details and choose Schedule for Future.
Set Frequency, Start Date and End Date, then confirm.

help.title: Paperless Preference
paragraphs: Enroll on the Paperless Preference page in Online Banking, or in the app tap the + button, View Services, then Paperless Preference, agree to the agreement and switch the toggle from Disabled to Enabled. You can also text PAPERLESS to 968772. You need an Online Banking account, and paperless statements require agreeing to receive other documents electronically too.

Up to 24 months of statements are available online. For older copies, chat with a representative, call 210-945-3300 or visit a branch. Credit card paperless statements are turned on separately from the card servicing site.

help.title: Reset your username or password
paragraphs: On the sign-in panel choose Forgot Your Username or Password?, or in the RBFCU Mobile app tap Having Trouble Signing In? and follow the prompts. Signed in to the app, change your username, password or security questions under the profile icon, Profile Settings, Security Center.

RBFCU asks you to allow or deny sign-ins from unrecognized devices by push, text or email. Besides app-based MFA, you can keep using one-time passcodes by text or phone call, or security questions. RBFCU employees will never ask for your codes.

help.title: Skip-A-Pay
paragraphs: Eligible members can skip an eligible auto or personal loan payment for $15 per skip. The skipped payment moves to the end of the term and interest keeps accruing. You cannot skip two months in a row or more than twice a calendar year, and the previous month's payment must be made first.

In Online Banking go to Loans on the Account Summary page and click the Skip-A-Pay is available link on an eligible loan; in the app tap the orange Skip-A-Pay calendar icon. Submit the request at least seven days before the due date. If the payment comes from another bank's ACH or a bill pay service, stop that payment yourself.

help.title: Changing your loan due date
paragraphs: Your first auto loan payment must be made on its original due date. After that, call the Collections Team at 210-945-3300 to ask for a different due date. For a new loan you can ask your Consumer Lending Specialist, before signing, for a first payment date up to 60 days after the loan is finalized.

help.title: Payment history and past statements
paragraphs: Up to 24 months of statements are available in Online Banking. Open Statements to view or download a past statement.
Payments you make online appear in your payment history; a pending payment shows until it posts.
steps: Open your payment history or statements.
Select a statement to view or download.

extra.intent: Using RBFCU's help pages, find the fee for each Skip-A-Pay request on an eligible loan. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
